logic.entry: WMA_k[j]=sum(i=1..k,i*C[j-k+i])/sum(i=1..k,i), newest weightk. Set half=floor(N/2),root=floor(sqrtN)=isqrt(N). raw[j]=2*WMA_half[j]-WMA_N[j];HMA[j]=WMA_root(raw)[j],complete windows only,Decimal28. First HMA indexN+root-2. delta[j]=HMA[j]-HMA[j-M] uses only completed daily closes. No EMA seed or fold reset. When flat, enter iff delta>0; no prior-cross requirement.
logic.exit: While long, exit iff delta<0. Exact zero preserves actual cash/held state. No future padding, price crossover/band, fold reset, short, hold cap or same-decision re-entry. Costed terminal liquidation.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)

sources.version_observed: Current author article, originally described as2005 work
